findings.recommendation: Bound connect/send/body and cleanup waits, and ensure caller timeout/cancellation cannot leave provider work holding the daemon lock.

findings.claim: Do not discard the managed Browser Use session after an unacknowledged stop.

Official docs state disconnect does not stop the cloud browser.

findings.recommendation: Check transport and HTTP stop outcome, surface failure, preserve the session ID for bounded retry/recovery, and qualify billing claims until stop is acknowledged.
